## Data Saurus

There are 13 datasets that have the same summary statistics but very different distributions.
This is the "dino".

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# install.packages("datasauRus")
library(datasauRus)
datasaurus_dozen |> 
  filter(dataset == "dino")
```

## As Visual

```{r}
datasaurus_dozen |> 
  filter(dataset == "dino") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal()
```

## All the datasets

```{r}
datasaurus_dozen |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = dataset)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 5) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summary statistics {.smaller}



```{r}
datasaurus_dozen |> 
  group_by(dataset) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_x = mean(x),
    mean_y = mean(y),
    sd_x = sd(x),
    sd_y = sd(y),
    cor_xy = cor(x, y)
  )
```
